req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-019 requires that POST /players/ commits a new player to the DB and that a subsequent GET returns it. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player returns 201 and is retrievable via GET; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad_number returns 409 and is not double-inserted; (3) boundary BVA — squad_number at the boundary of existing data (27, one above the highest seeded value 26) creates successfully; (4) DT — missing required field returns 422 (client error path); (5) STC — state transition: player absent → POST → player present, verified by GET. All assertions use exact values to kill constant/operator mutations. Squad numbers 27+ are safe to use as they are not in the pre-loaded fixture.

tests.name: test_post_player_returns_201_and_get_retrieves_it
preconditions: DB is pre-loaded with 26 rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the DB
actions: POST /players/ with a valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
Assert response JSON contains all submitted fields plus a UUID id
GET /players/squadnumber/99 and assert 200 with matching payload
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber=99, position, and a non-null id
GET /players/squadnumber/99 returns HTTP 200 with the same data
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_returns_201_and_get_retrieves_it():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    uuid.UUID(body["id"])  # must be valid UUID, raises ValueError if not
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/99")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert get_body["id"] == body["id"]

test_post_player_returns_201_and_get_retrieves_it()

tests.name: test_post_player_squad_number_boundary_above_max_seeded
preconditions: DB is pre-loaded with squad numbers 1-26 (max seeded = 26)
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=27 (one above max seeded value)
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 (boundary value 27 is valid)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_squad_number_boundary_above_max_seeded():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["firstName"] == "Boundary"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Test"
    assert body["position"] == "Centre-Back"
    uuid.UUID(body["id"])
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/27")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    assert get_r.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert get_r.json()["id"] == body["id"]

test_post_player_squad_number_boundary_above_max_seeded()

tests.name: test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422
actions: POST /players/ with payload missing required field 'position'
expected: No player is created in the DB
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422():
    # Missing 'position' which is required (non-optional in PlayerRequestModel)
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Missing",
        "lastName": "Position",
        "squadNumber": 88
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    # Confirm player was NOT persisted
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/88")
    assert get_r.status_code == 404

test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422()

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_absent_to_present
actions: Assert returned data matches posted data exactly
expected: Subsequent GET returns 200 with matching data — state transition confirmed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_absent_to_present():
    # State: absent
    pre_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert pre_get.status_code == 404
    # Transition: create
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "middleName": "Trans",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "LB",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    created = post_r.json()
    assert created["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert created["firstName"] == "State"
    assert created["middleName"] == "Trans"
    assert created["lastName"] == "Test"
    assert created["position"] == "Left-Back"
    assert created["starting11"] == True
    uuid.UUID(created["id"])
    # State: present
    post_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert post_get.status_code == 200
    fetched = post_get.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == created["id"]
    assert fetched["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert fetched["firstName"] == "State"
    assert fetched["lastName"] == "Test"
    assert fetched["starting11"] == True

test_post_player_state_transition_absent_to_present()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_set_correctly():

        "lastName": "Check",

tests.name: test_post_player_optional_fields_null_persisted_correctly
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields (all optional fields omitted)
Assert optional fields are null/None in response
GET /players/squadnumber/55 and assert optional fields are null
expected: middleName, dateOfBirth, abbrPosition, team, league, starting11 are null in response
GET confirms same null values persisted

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_optional_fields_null_persisted_correctly():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Minimal",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 55,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/55")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    gb = get_r.json()
    assert gb["middleName"] is None
    assert gb["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert gb["team"] is None
    assert gb["league"] is None
    assert gb["starting11"] is None

test_post_player_optional_fields_null_persisted_correctly()
